chats.answer:
If you're looking for the best dash cam with true radar-based parking mode, I'd focus on models that can detect movement around your parked car while using very little power.

Radar parking mode is different from conventional motion detection. A radar-equipped dash cam can remain in a low-power standby state and wake up when it detects someone approaching your vehicle.

The important distinction is true radar detection versus buffered parking recording. Some excellent dash cams have motion-triggered parking mode but no radar sensor.
